Oscar-winning adaptation of the Broadway hit about an English professor (Rex Harrison) who teaches a cockney merchant (Audrey Hepburn) to be a lady.
programme.title: My Fair Lady

programme.desc: Dr. Stein (Peter Cushing) and his assistant (Francis Matthews) sew up a new monster, Karl (Michael Gwynn).
programme.title: The Revenge of Frankenstein

programme.desc: Two sailors (Frank Sinatra, Gene Kelly) on leave in Hollywood help an actress (Kathryn Grayson) get her big break.
programme.title: Anchors Aweigh

programme.desc: Holmes (Basil Rathbone) and Watson (Nigel Bruce) follow a popular matchbook full of microfilm sought by Nazi spies.
programme.title: Sherlock Holmes in Washington

programme.desc: After returning to Hawaii from being in the army, a pineapple tycoon's rebellious son turns into an island tour guide with his girlfriend.
programme.title: Blue Hawaii

programme.desc: New York playgirl Holly Golightly puzzles a writer who lives in her building.
programme.title: Breakfast at Tiffany's

programme.desc: When a persistent posse threatens two outlaws' (Paul Newman, Robert Redford) romp through Wyoming, they decide to take their act to Bolivia.
programme.title: Butch Cassidy and the Sundance Kid

programme.desc: Rebel trucker "Rubber Duck" (Kris Kristofferson) blocks a crooked sheriff (Ernest Borgnine) with a CB-linked army of big rigs.
programme.title: Convoy

programme.desc: A screenwriter (William Holden) daydreams with his new secretary (Audrey Hepburn) in Paris instead of meeting a producer's (Noel Coward) deadline.
programme.title: Paris When It Sizzles

programme.desc: Jeb Stuart and George Custer get stationed at Fort Leavenworth in Kansas and work together to stop abolitionist John Brown.
programme.title: Santa Fe Trail

programme.desc: A doctor's unconventional theories of medicine and relationship with a young student place his reputation in jeopardy.
programme.title: People Will Talk

programme.desc: A man in a chair (James Cagney) comments as, one by one, characters enter Nick's (William Bendix) San Francisco bar.
programme.title: The Time of Your Life

programme.desc: A 110-year-old former Louisiana slave (Cicely Tyson) reminisces about her life and society from the Civil War to germinating civil rights.
programme.title: The Autobiography of Miss Jane Pittman

programme.desc: Two Navy inductees (Dean Martin, Jerry Lewis) go through basic training, then head for Honolulu by submarine for fun.
programme.title: Sailor Beware

programme.desc: White liberals must overcome their own latent racism when their strong-willed daughter announces her intention to marry a distinguished black physician.
programme.title: Guess Who's Coming to Dinner

programme.desc: Bumpkins Moe, Larry and Curly Joe (The Three Stooges) help an ice-skating Snow White (Carol Heiss) find her Prince Charming (Edson Stroll).
programme.title: Snow White and the Three Stooges

programme.desc: A black Southern woman (Whoopi Goldberg) struggles to find her identity after suffering years of abuse from her father and others over 40 years.
programme.title: The Color Purple

programme.desc: A singing cowboy (Roy Rogers) clears the outlaw (Donald Barry) and his gang of a bank robbery done by bankers.
programme.title: Days of Jesse James

programme.desc: A New Yorker and her four sons experience love and laughter from their opinionated but well-meaning family patriarch.
programme.title: Life With Father

programme.desc: New York playgirl Holly Golightly puzzles a writer who lives in her building.
programme.title: Breakfast at Tiffany's

programme.desc: A folksy New England poet (Gary Cooper) inherits $20 million he doesn't want and tells a New York newswoman (Jean Arthur) why.
programme.title: Mr. Deeds Goes to Town

programme.desc: The arrival of wealthy bachelors in town causes an uproar when families with single daughters aggressively seek engagements, including the Bennet family, with five eligible daughters.
programme.title: Pride and Prejudice

programme.desc: A suave stranger (Cary Grant) helps a chic widow (Audrey Hepburn) stalked by four men looking for loot in Paris.
programme.title: Charade

programme.desc: A missionary (Leo Genn) in Kenya tells a drifter (Cornel Wilde) his uranium-miner brother has been killed by leopard men.
programme.title: Beyond Mombasa

programme.desc: After a laboratory courtship, the Polish scientist (Greer Garson) and her French husband (Walter Pidgeon) discover radium in 1898.
programme.title: Madame Curie

programme.desc: Sherlock Holmes (Christopher Plummer) and Dr. Watson (James Mason) hunt Victorian London's Jack the Ripper, despite Scotland Yard.
programme.title: Murder by Decree

programme.desc: A reporter writes a fictitious column about a man named John Doe, who claims to despair at America's neglect of the little people and plans to kill himself. To maintain the ruse, the newspaper hires a ballplayer-turned-hobo to pose as John Doe.

S01 E167 — Throwing in the Shovel Police discover a badly injured suspect; an abuse suspect is arrested for using his collection of knives to threaten his wife; a thief explains that his vehicle was exchanged for drugs.
programme.title: Cops Reloaded

programme.desc: S01 E168 — Why Did the Zebra Cross the Road? A suspect claims that his mug shot photo is of his twin brother; officers lasso an escaped zebra; a stolen vehicle is revealed to have been handed off from one car thief to another; police question an intoxicated man.
programme.title: Cops Reloaded

programme.desc: S01 E169 — Questionable Circumstances An unruly motel guest's feet trip him up during a chase with police; police are applauded for quickly apprehending a robbery suspect; a car thief claims to be picking up the owner of her stolen vehicle.
programme.title: Cops Reloaded

programme.desc: S01 E170 — A Bad Mix Three juveniles are arrested for holding up the owner of a local eatery; a woman is found to have $9,000 worth of warrants; a drug dealer complains that he needs to make ends meet; a couple assaults their roommate.
programme.title: Cops Reloaded

programme.desc: S01 E171 — Trouble in Paradise A robbery suspect hides out in a dumpster; a man's blue shirt gets him stopped by police; a man's racially offensive name-calling gets him hobble-strapped; a driver's bloody hands make officers suspicious.
programme.title: Cops Reloaded

programme.desc: S01 E172 — Keeping Secrets A car passenger runs from police while the driver pulls a disappearing act; a flashy driver is nearly let off the hook until he reveals that he's been drinking; a female driver has poor hiding spots for her contraband.
programme.title: Cops Reloaded

programme.desc: S01 E173 — Blow This Taco Stand A robber, still located on the premises, can't hide from the K-9 unit; a driver can't convince officers that marijuana is harmless; a deviant finds himself on the run from a woman's husband after making an obscene inquiry.
programme.title: Cops Reloaded

programme.desc: S01 E174 — Pump the Breaks A man caught urinating in public gets into a lengthy scuffle with police; a car thief claims a crack addict let him borrow his car; police investigate a drunken bar fight; a couple seeks help.
programme.title: Cops Reloaded

programme.desc: S01 E175 — Redneck Rituals A criminal lectures officers on how the law works; a mother chastises her daughter after she is caught with drugs; a suicidal man claims to be just looking for attention; a father takes the fall for his son's drugs.
programme.title: Cops Reloaded

programme.desc: S01 E176 — Dog Search Police intervene on a chase between a car thief and the owner of the stolen vehicle; a manic pot grower goes in circles with police until he collapses; police investigate an assault on a homeless man.
programme.title: Cops Reloaded

programme.desc: S01 E177 — Pinch of Salt Police detain a robbery suspect responsible for holding a woman at gunpoint; a car chase suspect hits a dead end; a shaved down key proves a car thief's guilt; police caution a drug suspect on her lifestyle choices.
programme.title: Cops Reloaded

programme.desc: S01 E178 — Night Stalker Ecstasy dealers get a bad deal from undercover officers; a DUI suspect fails several field sobriety tests; police mediate a dispute between a couple over a dent in a wall; police arrest a man stalking his ex-wife and kids.
programme.title: Cops Reloaded
